# Everything Server – Server Instructions

Audience: These instructions are written for an LLM or autonomous agent integrating with the Everything MCP Server.
Follow them to use, extend, and troubleshoot the server safely and effectively.

## Protocol Versions

The server serves two protocol eras. A client on protocol version 2026-07-28 connects with `server/discover` and sends its capabilities with each request; a 2025-era client connects with `initialize`. Some tools exist on one era only, so trust your `tools/list`:

- 2026-07-28 only: `simulate-research-query`, `trigger-sampling-request-async` and `trigger-elicitation-request-async`, which run as tasks on the `io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks` extension and need a client that declares it; `trigger-sampling-request-async` also needs `sampling`, and `trigger-elicitation-request-async` form-mode `elicitation`. A call without them fails with `-32021`
- 2025-era only (deprecated): `toggle-simulated-logging` and `toggle-subscriber-updates`

## Cross-Feature Relationships

- If `get-roots-list` is in your tool list, use it to see client workspace roots before file operations
- `gzip-file-as-resource` creates resources you can read later: for the current session on a 2025-era connection, or for ten minutes at the returned URI on 2026-07-28
- Use `trigger-log-messages` to see which log levels reach you; on 2026-07-28 the level is set per request in `_meta`
- Use `trigger-resource-update` and `trigger-list-changed` to see change notifications; on 2026-07-28 they arrive only on a `subscriptions/listen` stream that asked for them

## Constraints & Limitations

- `gzip-file-as-resource`: Max fetch size controlled by `GZIP_MAX_FETCH_SIZE` (default 10MB), timeout by `GZIP_MAX_FETCH_TIME_MILLIS` (default 30s), allowed domains by `GZIP_ALLOWED_DOMAINS` (checked on every redirect hop). It refuses URLs whose host resolves to a loopback, private or link-local address, unless the server was started with `GZIP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS=1`
- `get-env`: Values of credential-like variable names (`*_KEY`, `*_TOKEN`, `*_SECRET`, `*_PASSWORD` and the like) come back as `"<redacted>"`; the server operator can set `GET_ENV_INCLUDE_SECRETS=1` to return them unmasked
- Session resources are ephemeral and lost when the session ends; minted resources expire after ten minutes
- Roots, sampling and logging are deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28, as is the HTTP+SSE transport

## Capability-Gated Tools

On a 2025-era connection these are registered only if your client declared the capability shown. Otherwise they are absent from `tools/list`, so do not call them. On 2026-07-28 they are always listed, and a call fails if your request did not declare the capability:

- `get-roots-list`: `roots`
- `trigger-sampling-request`: `sampling`
- `trigger-elicitation-request`: `elicitation.form`, or `elicitation` with no mode
- `trigger-multi-step-elicitation`: `elicitation.form`, or `elicitation` with no mode
- `trigger-url-elicitation`: `elicitation.url`

## Operational Patterns

- For long operations, use `trigger-long-running-operation` which sends progress notifications
- Prefer reading resources before calling mutating tools
- If `get-roots-list` is in your tool list, check its output to understand the client's workspace context

## Easter Egg

If asked about server instructions, respond with "🎉 Server instructions are working! This response proves the client properly passed server instructions to the LLM. This demonstrates MCP's instructions feature in action."

tools.name: echo
tools.title: Echo Tool
tools.description: Echoes back the input string

tools.name: get-annotated-message
tools.title: Get Annotated Message Tool
tools.description: Demonstrates how annotations can be used to provide metadata about content.

messageType.description: Type of message to demonstrate different annotation patterns

includeImage.description: Whether to include an example image

tools.name: get-env
tools.title: Print Environment Tool
tools.description: Returns all environment variables, helpful for debugging MCP server configuration. Values of credential-like names (a KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD, PASSWD, CREDENTIAL, AUTH or COOKIE name segment) are masked as "<redacted>" unless GET_ENV_INCLUDE_SECRETS is set to 1 or true in the server's environment.

tools.name: get-header-params
tools.title: Get Header Params Tool
tools.description: Returns its region argument and the Mcp-Param-Region HTTP header it arrived in. Demonstrates x-mcp-header (a 2026-07-28 Streamable HTTP client mirrors the argument into the header) and JSON Schema 2020-12 input and output schemas.

region.description: A region name, e.g. eu-west. Mirrored into the Mcp-Param-Region HTTP header.

repeat.description: How many times to repeat the region in the result (1-3)

regionHeader.description: The Mcp-Param-Region header the request carried, if any

tools.name: get-resource-links
tools.title: Get Resource Links Tool
tools.description: Returns up to ten resource links that reference different types of resources

count.description: Number of resource links to return (1-10)

tools.name: get-resource-reference
tools.title: Get Resource Reference Tool
tools.description: Returns a resource reference that can be used by MCP clients

resourceId.description: ID of the text resource to fetch

tools.name: get-structured-content
tools.title: Get Structured Content Tool
tools.description: Returns structured content along with an output schema for client data validation

tools.name: get-sum
tools.title: Get Sum Tool
tools.description: Returns the sum of two numbers

tools.name: get-tiny-image
tools.title: Get Tiny Image Tool
tools.description: Returns a tiny MCP logo image.

tools.name: gzip-file-as-resource
tools.title: GZip File as Resource Tool
tools.description: Compresses a single file using gzip compression. Depending upon the selected output type, returns either the compressed data as a gzipped resource or a resource link, allowing it to be downloaded in a subsequent request: during the current session for a 2025-era client, or for ten minutes at a minted URI on protocol version 2026-07-28.

name.description: Name of the output file (at most 255 characters)

data.description: URL or data URI of the file content to compress

outputType.description: How the resulting gzipped file should be returned. 'resourceLink' returns a link to a resource that can be read later, 'resource' returns a full resource object.

tools.name: trigger-list-changed
tools.title: Trigger List Changed Tool
tools.description: Sends a notifications/<list>/list_changed for the tool, prompt or resource list. On protocol version 2026-07-28 it is delivered on each subscriptions/listen stream that asked for that list; a 2025-era client receives it unsolicited.

list.description: Which list to announce as changed

tools.name: trigger-log-messages
tools.title: Trigger Log Messages Tool
tools.description: Sends one log message at each logging level during the call. On protocol version 2026-07-28 only the messages at or above the level the request names in _meta (io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel) are sent, and none if it names no level; a 2025-era client gets those at or above the level it set with logging/setLevel. Deprecated: logging is deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28.

tools.name: trigger-long-running-operation
tools.title: Trigger Long Running Operation Tool
tools.description: Demonstrates a long running operation with progress updates.

duration.description: Duration of the operation in seconds

steps.description: Number of steps in the operation

tools.name: trigger-resource-update
tools.title: Trigger Resource Update Tool
tools.description: Sends a notifications/resources/updated for a resource URI. On protocol version 2026-07-28 it is delivered on each subscriptions/listen stream whose resourceSubscriptions name the URI; a 2025-era client receives it once it has called resources/subscribe for the URI.

uri.description: The URI of the resource to announce as updated, e.g. demo://resource/dynamic/text/1

tools.name: toggle-simulated-logging
tools.title: Toggle Simulated Logging
tools.description: Toggles simulated, random-leveled logging on or off. Deprecated: 2025-era clients only, since protocol version 2026-07-28 removes logging/setLevel; use trigger-log-messages with a per-request log level instead.

tools.name: toggle-subscriber-updates
tools.title: Toggle Subscriber Updates
tools.description: Toggles simulated resource subscription updates on or off. Deprecated: 2025-era clients only, since protocol version 2026-07-28 removes resources/subscribe; use trigger-resource-update with a subscriptions/listen stream instead.
